bio: Park at the tip of the peninsula with Quarantine Station buildings, forts and tunnels, linked by a shuttle.
gaps: Fort Nepean Engine House and The Bend beach steps closed per agency; bio does not promise them. Fee not stated.

bio: Geothermal springs and day spa at Fingal, with over 70 bathing experiences, under 90 minutes from Melbourne.
Active 1859 limestone lighthouse at the peninsula's southern tip, with guided tower climbs and a keeper's house museum.
Fort at the peninsula's tip that guarded Port Phillip in both world wars, with tunnels between the gun emplacements.
gaps: Engine House and its track closed (landslip); not promised.

bio: Ocean beaches, Greens Bush and clifftop walks between Portsea and Flinders, with surf beaches at Gunnamatta and Rye.
Seaside town between ocean and bay beaches, site of an 1803 convict settlement, with a ferry to Queenscliff.
Rural town of cool-climate wineries known for pinot noir, with farm-gate strawberries, cherries and apples in season.
A 26 km walk from Dromana to Cape Schanck through Arthurs Seat and Greens Bush, done in two days or in sections.
Two-day walk along high clifftops and past ocean beaches in Mornington Peninsula National Park.
gaps: Route start/end and length not sourced.

bio: Sandy beach ringed by basalt cliffs, reached by a 5.4 km return walk from Cape Schanck, with low-tide rockpools.
Hill reserve whose 314 m summit looks to the Melbourne skyline on clear days, with walks and a Kings Falls circuit.
Blowhole best seen at low tide from a headland lookout, with a steep stepped track down to the rockpools.
Ocean beach on the Bass Strait side of Portsea, patrolled in summer holidays, with surfing and rockpools.
Surf beach in Mornington Peninsula National Park that draws experienced surfers, patrolled in summer holidays.
Wetland reserve and homestead at Somers on Western Port Bay, with the homestead open Wednesdays and weekends.
Largest town on the peninsula's bay side, with a main street running down to the pier, cafes and a racecourse.
Home of artist Georgiana McCrae, who drew its plan herself in 1845, showing domestic life of the 1840s.
gaps: Located at McCrae (11 Beverley Road), not Rosebud.

bio: Early homestead holding Napoleon memorabilia, set in a wildlife sanctuary and gardens with free park entry.
Surf beach on Bass Strait with powerful waves and reef breaks, plus a long sandy shoreline to walk.
Clifftop track above Sorrento Ocean Beach, with stairs to a lookout platform, through coastal scrub to Diamond Bay.
Marine sanctuary with a mushroom-shaped reef off Flinders, good for rockpools, snorkelling and diving, with no fishing.
Hot-springs spa in native bushland with outdoor geothermal rain and forest pools, plus private rooftop pools.
gaps: General entry price not found; commercial venue.

bio: Little penguins waddle home to their burrows at sunset every night, watched from boardwalks at Summerlands Beach.

name: Koala Conservation Centre
bio: Tree-top boardwalks over koalas in their natural habitat, plus bush trails with wallabies and echidnas.
